meta.title: ZZZ character stage
meta.description: Adds the event card's lead character 德蕾琪娜·挽昼 (wearing the 柔光之影 outfit) as an animated Spine figure on the composer's top-right corner (click to fade it to a ghost that lets clicks through; hover it to lock the ghost in place, and the lock is remembered by the browser), and swaps the whale tail in the running Deep-diving indicator for the event page's spinning little yellow flower.
